notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
[h1]It's past time for a progress update so let's fill you in on all the latest![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35411862/a32d92804414f990fb65fc071f87a9ff6ff0a54d.png[/img]

Our current release date is planned for [b]December 2021[/b] (as long as nothing goes wrong... lol)

The script's draft is written and currently being revised. We're planning to have revisions complete by late summer/early fall.

Illustrations are being planned, final backgrounds are being worked on, and music tracks are being composed. We are busy busy busy!

We are now meeting weekly to keep game development going smoothly and are going to have some really cool stuff to show off as time ticks down to release.

Like this new route selection screen!
[previewyoutube=5n1y24hDtRQ;full][/previewyoutube]

If you backed us on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/scribble-games/in-blood-a-visual-novel-game/posts]Kickstarter[/url] be sure to check out our monthly progress reports over there, you can also support me on [url=https://www.patreon.com/JaimeScribbles]Patreon[/url] for some cool perks, and pick up some nifty merch over at [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/JaimeScribbles/shop?asc=u]redbubble[/url].
